rows.reasoning: The manufacturer defines the instrument as a volumetric gas adsorption analyzer. What it measures is the quantity of gas adsorbed by a powder sample versus pressure (isotherm reports, weight percent H2, Pressure Composition Isotherm; pp. 1, 4-5). The LN2 Dewar is only a constant-temperature bath for the sample tube (p. 7: 'Prepare a Dewar with cryogen'). Nothing in the procedure measures cryogen boiloff flow or heat leak through an insulation specimen. A steady-state boiloff calorimeter is a different kind of instrument, so this function is not provided.
